verdict.rationale: Vestd markets a dedicated migration offering ('Migrate to Vestd – Digitise or move your existing scheme', plus a /migrate page) and promises to replace messy spreadsheets with 'one source of truth, reconciled'. The evidence is only headline marketing, with no description of how the migration works. Missing for 10: a documented guided import flow (spreadsheet or other-platform importers), validation of imported data, reconciliation against source documents, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
